Preparation Procedure: - Take an Aliquot of the "A" Sample for the ITP as soon as possible upon reception and analyze it immediately or store it at approximately 4 °C for a maximum of 24 h before analysis (within a maximum of 4 days from Sample collection). Alternatively, keep the ''A'' Sample Aliquots frozen until analysis. - Keep the remainder of the "A'' Sample not used for the ITP in the Sample collection tube or aliquot it into new vials, which shall be properly labelled to ensure LCOC documentation, and stored them frozen until the "A" CP, if needed.

- Freeze the "B" Sample as soon as possible upon reception and thaw it before analysis. - Once the "B" Sample is thawed and opened, re-seal the remaining serum fraction not used for the "B" CP in front of the Athlete or the Athlete's representative or an Independent Witness, as applicable, using a tamper- evident system. Keep the Sample in frozen storage until Further Analysis, if needed.
